candidates.description: The login route interpolates req.body.email directly into a SQL query string without parameterization, allowing SQL injection through the email field.
candidates.rationale: Line 34 uses template literal interpolation of req.body.email into a sequelize.query call. The email value flows from POST body without sanitization or parameterized binding, enabling classic SQL injection to bypass authentication or extract data.
candidates.title: SQL injection via email parameter in login query

candidates.description: The chat route passes productId directly into a MongoDB $where JavaScript expression, allowing arbitrary JavaScript execution in the database query context.
candidates.rationale: Line 149 constructs a $where clause by string-concatenating productId into a JavaScript expression evaluated by MongoDB. An attacker controlling productId can inject arbitrary JS that executes server-side in the database engine.
candidates.title: NoSQL injection via $where operator in chat route

candidates.description: The showProductReviews route concatenates the id parameter into a MongoDB $where JavaScript expression, enabling server-side code injection.
candidates.rationale: Line 36 builds a $where query by concatenating the id parameter into a JavaScript string evaluated by MongoDB. The id originates from a route parameter without type coercion or validation, allowing injection of arbitrary JS expressions.
candidates.title: NoSQL injection via $where operator in showProductReviews route

candidates.description: The zip extraction in fileUpload.ts validates that the resolved path is under CWD but not under the intended uploads/complaints directory, allowing writes to sibling directories via ../ in zip entry names.
candidates.rationale: Line 33 checks absolutePath.includes(path.resolve('.')) which only ensures the path is under CWD, not under uploads/complaints/. A zip entry named '../config/evil.js' resolves to a path still under CWD, passing the check, while the write on line 34 uses the raw relative path escaping the intended directory.
candidates.title: Zip slip allows file write outside intended directory
